INS.reason: No insulin entry in the 278-marker registry. C-peptide and insulin are cleaved from the same proinsulin and co-packaged 1:1. The marker NAME also conditions the model's text embedding, so this is a language-side substitution too. Measured by the marker-dropout check, three-way, including a trained-but-wrong-name control.

note: Contains ONLY names the installed package cannot resolve on its own. Anything the package already resolves (verbatim, or via its own alias table) is deliberately absent so this file never silently forks from upstream.
